title: solutions-pro-services-weekly-sync-notes-2026-08-11
content:
Weekly sync notes — Solutions + Pro Services (Tue 2026-08-11)
Time: 10:00-10:45 PT
Attendees: Ariana Chen (owner), Diego Martinez, Priya Nair, Liam O'Connor, Sofia Alvarez, Alex R. (Engineering SRE - on call)
Absent: none

Agenda:
- Quick round-robin: customer status highlights
- Blockers requiring infra/legal/pm escalation
- Dedicated capacity provisioning updates
- Upcoming demos / cutover windows
- Action items and owners

TL;DR Highlights:
- Acme Health: staging smoke tests passed; VPC peering + KMS keys pending final auth (target: 8/14)
- FinBank: SSO + audit logging still blocked by compliance - expect extra 2 weeks unless SOC checklist expedited
- EduPro: model pin and quantization validation done; latency regression observed on long-context tests (p99 ~ 420ms -> investigating)
- Dedicated pool provisioning queued with infra; expected ready 8/18 if quota approved today

Notes / Customer-by-customer:
1) Acme Health (priority: high)
- Status: Integration sprint 3. Staging smoke tests ran 8/10: generation, streaming, and embeddings passed basic flows.
- Remaining items:
  - VPC peering: Cloud network team needs one final approval from Acme netops (ticket PROSERV-784). Waiting on Acme to approve route table change.
  - KMS/HSM: customer provided KMS key alias; our infra needs to add key ARN to account mapping. Security has requested proof-of-possession doc from Acme (action: Priya).
- Blockers: routing approval + KMS doc. Without routing cannot run heavy load tests.
- Next steps:
  - Diego to send routing template to Acme by 8/11 EOD (ACTION: Diego)
  - Priya to follow up with security request + example key manifest by 8/12 (ACTION: Priya)
  - Target: full staging load test 8/15, cutover window 8/20-8/21

2) FinBank (priority: critical)
- Status: Security/compliance gate. SSO (SAML) integration partially wired; assertion attributes mismatch causing 401s on session creation.
- Logging & audit: audit-log delivery to customer SIEM still failing; logs truncated (see SERV-1342).
- Blockers:
  - Compliance needs SOC2 scoping confirmation for our Private deployment (legal loop). Estimated 2-week delay unless legal accelerates review.
  - SAML attribute mapping requires FinBank to update idp configuration; they are on PTO this week.
- Actions:
  - Liam to create detailed mapping doc + sample assertion for FinBank on 8/11 (ACTION: Liam)
  - Ariana to request prioritized legal review; propose 3 business-day SLA on SOC2 scoping (ACTION: Ariana)
  - If legal cannot accelerate, propose a temporary hosted solution with IP allowlist (fallback) — discuss with PM.

3) EduPro (priority: medium)
- Status: model pin + quantization tests complete on our internal harness. Deployed v1.2-q4 to dedicated staging.
- Issue observed: longer-context prompt tests show p99 latency increased from ~420ms to ~580ms after quantized kernel update (not consistent across GPUs).
- Investigation:
  - SRE to run targeted kernel profiling next 48 hours. Early hypothesis: kernel fallback for attention + KV cache flush on sequence lengths >4096 is causing path divergence.
  - Action: Alex R. to schedule profiling run and collect traces (ACTION: Alex)
- Customer communication: inform EduPro that we are prioritizing performance; no change to go-live date yet but will update by 8/14.

Dedicated capacity / Provisioning updates:
- Capacity request (Ticket: PROVISION-212) submitted 8/09. Quota approved pending billing/commit sign-off. Finance needs committed spend confirmation.
- If commit confirmed this week we can schedule node build 8/14-8/17; expected readiness 8/18.
- Action: Diego to get finance signoff and confirm with infra by 8/12 (ACTION: Diego)

Operational metrics / recent runs:
- Staging smoke for Acme: 1k requests, 99.5% success, avg latency 220ms, p95 370ms, p99 610ms (small sample).
- Load test note: memory leak seen in worker 3 during long-run (related to open file handles) - SRE investigating (see SERV-1399).

Blockers & escalations:
- Legal: SOC2 scoping for FinBank (Ariana to escalate).
- Infra: KMS ARN mapping need (Priya) + quota confirmation (Diego).
- Engineering: kernel fallback causing latency for EduPro (Alex + serving-runtime team).

Decisions made:
- Proceed with tentative cutover windows but lock final cutover only after KMS + routing done for Acme.
- If FinBank legal cannot expedite, offer hosted short-term fallback to unblock P0 business flows.

Action items (owner - due):
- Diego Martinez - send VPC routing template to Acme (due 2026-08-11 EOD)
- Priya Nair - provide KMS proof-of-possession template to Acme + update security ticket (PROSERV-784) (due 2026-08-12)
- Liam O'Connor - produce SAML attribute mapping doc for FinBank (due 2026-08-12)
- Ariana Chen - escalate SOC2 scoping to legal & request 3-business-day turn (due 2026-08-12)
- Alex R. - run kernel profiling for EduPro p99 regression and share traces (SERV-1399) (due 2026-08-13)
- Diego Martinez - confirm finance commit for dedicated pool (PROVISION-212) (due 2026-08-12)

Meeting notes / chatter (raw):
- Diego: "If Acme delays routing we might do proxy-ing but that'll complicate logs and KMS flow"
- Priya: "Security will accept HSM-backed keys but need attestation; pushing template today"
- Liam: "FinBank idp team usually takes 5 business days to push changes; should we plan FW option?"
- Ariana: "Agree — plan hosted fallback; need to document rollback steps and customer expectations"

Follow-ups / next meeting:
- Next sync: Tue 2026-08-18 10:00 PT (same cadence)
- Please update tickets before EOD on your due dates. We'll do a quick escalation if any item stalls beyond due date.

Attachments / links referenced:
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PROS/Acme+Health+Integration
- Jira: PROSERV-784, SERV-1342, SERV-1399, PROVISION-212
- GitHub PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/provisioning/pull/212

Notes to self (Ariana)
- Track legal escalation today, loop in VP Legal if no response by 8/12 noon.
- Prep customer status slide for next leadership readout (include Acme/FinBank timelines)

End of notes.
